source: Previously retained volume_dry_ratio direction in production-vcp-continuous-dimension-audit-train-2016-2022-v1; user preference and goal.md authorize a new actual-selector experiment. The earlier diagnostic itself did not authorize automatic strategy promotion.
exposure: Training 2016-2022 repeatedly exposed, including the prior generic-breakout annual-quintile study and the latest ten-session entry study. One fixed selector; no window, quantile or direction search. Historical family-wide significance is not established by local inference.
candidate_definition: Recompute the frozen QuantsLegacyVcpStrategy and archived default params on the original historical-union symbols and immutable archive; use every breakout signal code 0 in the signal period. Exclude cheat by signal type, never by future fill/label. This is a reconstructed archive candidate stream, not a claim of byte-identical live-data candidates.
feature: mean volume of last 10 observed asset bars before signal / mean volume of the preceding 30 observed asset bars; all 40 strictly pre-signal volumes must be finite and positive. Exactly the earlier retained 10/30 disjoint windows, not the separate 10/50 overlapping diagnostic.
selector: Within each original signal date select ratios <= that date's median. Keep ties together; singletons/all-tied dates retain all and have zero selection difference. Report informative dates separately. Missing-feature opportunities remain reported but are unavailable to both comparison portfolios.
execution: Identical next market-session open entries and s+11 open scheduled exits. Existing independent matcher and archived-name limit flags; unfilled stays cash, blocked terminal sale is censored with last observed close mark. No portfolio slots, stop, delayed entry or post-hoc exclusion.
benchmark: Reuse the same immutable-archive gross SH/SZ daily equal-weight observed-price benchmark from intact-pivot-pullback-entry-train-v1/execution-r3; include the full common open-to-open window. Return differences, not CAR or risk-adjusted alpha.
primary: Signal-date equal-weight selected net return minus all feature-valid candidates' net return; include singleton dates. Secondary primary gate is selected minus broad benchmark. Report joint calendar-block bootstrap 95% and local Bonferroni 97.5% intervals; not whole-history search correction.
diagnostics: All selected/rejected/whole-pool returns, each year, daily Rank IC on nonconstant cross-sections, executed/cash/censored counts, missing-feature counts, selected-set replacement on consecutive signal dates (not account turnover), and censor zero-recovery sensitivity.
decision: Failure stops this actual selector and adjacent volume windows/quantiles/direction reversals. Passing permits portfolio and exposure analysis only; no live qualification or clean holdout claim. No waiting for future sessions.
